host_processor_caches: L1d 48 KiB + L1i 32 KiB per core, L2 1 MiB per core, L3 384 MiB per socket
host_networking: 2x NVIDIA ConnectX-7 (MT2910) per node, InfiniBand 200 Gb/s (2X NDR) per port
host_networking_topology: 2 nodes interconnected via InfiniBand 200 Gb/s (2X NDR); one HCA per 4-GPU NVLink island (PCIe switch shared with the GPUs)
accelerator_interconnect: NVLink (H200 NVL 4-way bridge, NV6 = 6 bonded links between GPUs)
accelerator_interconnect_topology: Per node: 2 NVLink domains of 4 GPUs (GPU0-3 on socket 0, GPU4-7 on socket 1), fully connected within each domain; PCIe/Infinity Fabric between domains
hw_notes: GPU power limit 550 W; SM clock locked at 1300 MHz for job 137 only
sw_notes: SCC26 submission, team SegFAUlt; 12 ranks: 8 on deuterium + 4 on tritium GPUs 0-3 (RANK_LAYOUT, srun --distribution=arbitrary); accelerators_per_node = 6 is the average of 8 + 4. Run with Apptainer 1.5.3 (no Docker/Enroot) under Slurm 25.11.2; container built from nvcr.io/nvidia/pytorch:26.04-py3 (source-or-patches/nemo/llama-zeph.def). NVIDIA NeMo / Megatron-Bridge code from NVIDIA's MLPerf Training v6.0 submission, unchanged; Apptainer launcher in benchmarks/llama2_70b_lora/source-or-patches/helma.
interconnect: NVLink 4-way bridges inside each 4-GPU island; PCIe Gen5 between the two islands of deuterium; 2x InfiniBand 200 Gb/s per node between deuterium and tritium
interconnect_topology: 3 x 4-GPU NVLink islands (2 on deuterium, 1 on tritium): tensor parallel 4 inside each island, data parallel 3 across islands (PCIe and InfiniBand)
